_comment: SECRET: read only by scripts/judge.mjs. Each mutant is a deliberately seeded bug switched on with BUGS=<id> in practice-app/server.mjs. 'description' is shown only after the learner's tests catch it; 'hint' is the category shown when it is missed. Every mutant must violate a rule stated in src/content/pwlab.ts, and judge/reference/*.spec.ts must catch it.

mutants.description: A locked account could sign in (the lock check was skipped).
mutants.hint: Negative test: a special kind of account

mutants.description: Passwords were compared case-insensitively, so 'secret123!' worked as well as 'Secret123!'.
mutants.hint: Negative test: almost-correct credentials

mutants.description: A valid username with an empty password signed the user in.
mutants.hint: Required fields, one at a time

mutants.description: Log out only changed the page; the server session stayed alive, so protected pages still opened.
mutants.hint: State after an action: what is still reachable?

mutants.description: Search was case-sensitive ('backpack' found nothing).
mutants.hint: Equivalence classes of the search text

mutants.description: Search did not ignore leading/trailing spaces, so ' tote ' found nothing.
mutants.hint: Input formatting the user doesn't see

mutants.description: When search text was entered the category filter was ignored.
mutants.hint: Combinations of inputs

mutants.description: The 'No products match your search.' message never appeared for zero results.
mutants.hint: Edge case: zero results

mutants.description: Name sorting was case-sensitive, so 'iPhone Case' was sorted after every capitalised name.
mutants.hint: Data that is slightly different from the rest

mutants.description: Price sorting compared whole dollars only, so $9.99 came before $9.49.
mutants.hint: Check the whole order, not just the first item

mutants.description: Price high-to-low was the low-to-high list reversed, so products with the same price came Z to A.
mutants.hint: Ties

mutants.description: Typing a search or changing the category silently went back to Name (A to Z) while the dropdown still showed the chosen sort.
mutants.hint: State: one feature combined with another

mutants.description: Quantity 11 was accepted (off-by-one on the maximum).
mutants.hint: Boundary values

mutants.description: The cart badge did not update after removing an item.
mutants.hint: Every place that shows the same data

mutants.description: Reloading the page emptied the cart.
mutants.hint: State after reload

mutants.description: Choosing Cancel in the 'Empty cart' confirmation still emptied the cart.
mutants.hint: Dialogs: both answers

mutants.description: The postcode accepted letters, e.g. '56A001'.
mutants.hint: Invalid characters in a formatted field

mutants.description: An 11-digit phone number was accepted.
mutants.hint: Boundary values of a length rule

mutants.description: A first name made only of spaces was accepted.
mutants.hint: Input that looks filled in but isn't

mutants.description: Last name was not required.
mutants.hint: Check every required field, not just the first

mutants.description: Promo codes were case-sensitive ('save10' was rejected).
mutants.hint: Equivalence classes of the code text

mutants.description: The expired code WELCOME5 was accepted.
mutants.hint: Decision table: every kind of code

mutants.description: FLAT20 required MORE than $100.00 instead of at least $100.00 (exactly $100.00 was rejected).
mutants.hint: Boundary values

mutants.description: FLAT20 was applied below the minimum order value.
mutants.hint: Decision table: condition not met

mutants.description: A second promo code was accepted and both discounts stacked.
mutants.hint: Doing the same action twice

mutants.description: Tax was calculated on the subtotal before the discount.
mutants.hint: Calculation order with a promo applied

mutants.description: Tax was truncated instead of rounded, so totals were a cent short (e.g. $53.98 instead of $53.99).
mutants.hint: Exact arithmetic, to the cent

mutants.description: The receipt (new tab) showed a total that ignored the discount.
mutants.hint: Compare two pages that show the same data

mutants.description: The cart was not emptied after the order was placed.
mutants.hint: State after the flow completes

mutants.description: GET /api/orders without a token returned 200 instead of 401.
mutants.hint: Authentication: missing credentials

mutants.description: A user could delete another user's order.
mutants.hint: Authorization: two different users

mutants.description: POST /api/orders returned 200 instead of 201 Created.
mutants.hint: Exact status codes

mutants.description: POST /api/orders accepted a quantity of 11.
mutants.hint: Boundary values in the request body

mutants.description: GET /api/products/{id} for an unknown id returned 200 instead of 404.
mutants.hint: Negative test: a resource that doesn't exist
